#seed gene perturbation
```{r}
# seed gene perturbation

library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

obj_sim <- readRDS("/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/simulate_data_new2.rds")

# Get count matrix
count <- Seurat::GetAssayData(obj_sim, assay = "RNA", slot = "counts")

# Get metadata
metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data
metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

stopifnot(identical(colnames(count), metadata$cell))

# Step 1. Load 27 default seed genes 
load("~/scRhythmBayes/data/merge_27seedgenes_bmal1.Rdata")

seed27 <- unique(as.character(seed27_in))
seed27 <- seed27[seed27 %in% rownames(count)]

length(seed27)
seed27

if (length(seed27) != 27) {
  stop("The number of matched seed genes is not 27. Please check seed27_in and count rownames.")
}

# Step 2. Set benchmark design 
seed_n_vec <- c(27, 20, 15, 10, 5,0)
n_repeat <- 5

out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_seed_number"
dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
seed_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "seed_sets")

dir.create(phase_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(seed_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Step 3. Run cell-phase inference under different seed-number conditions
set.seed(2026)

seed_record_all <- list()
run_id <- 1

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {
  
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    
    message("Running seed-number benchmark")
    message("n_seed = ", n_seed, " | repeat = ", rep_id)
    
    # Select seed genes
    if (n_seed == 27) {
      seed_use <- seed27
    }
    
    if (n_seed < 27) {
      seed_use <- sample(seed27, size = n_seed, replace = FALSE)
    }
    
    message("Selected seed genes:")
    message(paste(seed_use, collapse = ", "))
    
    # Save selected seed genes
    seed_record_i <- tibble(
      n_seed = n_seed,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      seed_gene = seed_use
    )
    
    seed_file <- file.path(
      seed_dir,
      paste0("seed_genes_seed", n_seed, "_rep", rep_id, ".csv")
    )
    
    write_csv(seed_record_i, seed_file)
    
    seed_record_all[[run_id]] <- seed_record_i
    
    write_csv(
      bind_rows(seed_record_all),
      file.path(out_dir, "seed_gene_sets_all.csv")
    )
    
    # Run cell-phase inference
    res_phase <- infer_cell_phase(
      count = count,
      metadata = metadata,
      ZT_by = "ZT_sym",
      strata_by = "celltype",
      seedgene = seed_use,
      Species = "mouse",
      n_grid = 60,
      n_iter_outer = 5,
      n_iter_seed = 3,
      Kappa = 5,
      p_mix = 0.85,
      Min_n = 200,
      setseed = 2026 + rep_id,
      Verbose = TRUE
    )
    
    # Add benchmark information
    res_phase$n_seed <- n_seed
    res_phase$repeat_id <- rep_id
    
    # Save cell-phase result
    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_seed", n_seed, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )
    
    saveRDS(res_phase, phase_file)
    
    message("Finished n_seed = ", n_seed, " | repeat = ", rep_id)
    
    run_id <- run_id + 1
    
    rm(res_phase, seed_record_i)
    gc()
  }
}

# Step 4. Save file index
phase_index <- expand.grid(
  n_seed = seed_n_vec,
  repeat_id = seq_len(n_repeat)
) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_seed), repeat_id) %>%
  mutate(
    res_phase_file = file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_seed", n_seed, "_rep", repeat_id, ".rds")
    ),
    seed_file = file.path(
      seed_dir,
      paste0("seed_genes_seed", n_seed, "_rep", repeat_id, ".csv")
    )
  )

write_csv(
  phase_index,
  file.path(out_dir, "res_phase_file_index.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  phase_index,
  file.path(out_dir, "res_phase_file_index.rds")
)

```

# seed gene perturbation CDF plot
```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(Matrix)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(readr)

obj_sim <- readRDS("/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/simulate_data_new2.rds")

# Get metadata
metadata <- obj_sim@meta.data
metadata$cell <- rownames(metadata)

# Step 1. Set input and output paths
out_dir <- "/Users/zhangqian/scRhythmBayes/data/Benchmark/benchmark_seed_number"

phase_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "res_phase")
plot_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "plots_cell_phase")

dir.create(plot_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

seed_n_vec <- c(27,20,15,10,5,0)
n_repeat <- 5


# Step 2. Set colors
seed_cols <- c(
  "27" = "#A8C7E6",
  "20" = "#17441e",
  "15" = "#3a621f",
  "10" = "#bdc3ac",
  "5"  = "#357090",
  "0" =  "#C2E2C2"
)
# Step 3. Calculate CDF, AUC, and MedAE for each run
auc_all <- list()
cdf_all <- list()

run_id <- 1

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {
  
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    
    message("Processing n_seed = ", n_seed, " | repeat = ", rep_id)
    
    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_seed", n_seed, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )
    
    res_phase <- readRDS(phase_file)
    
    res_eval <- res_phase %>%
      left_join(
        metadata %>%
          select(cell, t_true, theta_rad, ZT_sym, celltype),
        by = "cell"
      )
    
    # Calculate circular absolute error in hours
    diff_h <- abs((res_eval$ZT_pred - res_eval$t_true) %% 24)
    err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
    
    err_h <- sort(err_h)
    
    # Use the same threshold definition as the previous Python code
    hrsoff <- c(0, err_h, 12)
    
    frac_wrong <- sapply(
      hrsoff,
      function(hrtol) {
        100 * sum(err_h > hrtol) / length(err_h)
      }
    )
    
    pct_correct <- 100 - frac_wrong
    
    norm_pct_correct <- pct_correct / 100
    norm_hrsoff <- hrsoff / 12
    
    auc <- sum(norm_pct_correct[-length(norm_pct_correct)] * diff(norm_hrsoff))
    medae <- median(err_h)
    
    auc_i <- tibble(
      n_seed = n_seed,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      AUC = auc,
      MedAE = medae,
      n_cell = length(err_h)
    )
    
    cdf_i <- tibble(
      n_seed = n_seed,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      threshold_h = hrsoff,
      pct_correct = pct_correct
    )
    
    auc_all[[run_id]] <- auc_i
    cdf_all[[run_id]] <- cdf_i
    
    run_id <- run_id + 1
    
    rm(res_phase, res_eval, err_h, diff_h, hrsoff, frac_wrong, pct_correct)
    gc()
  }
}

auc_all <- bind_rows(auc_all)
cdf_all <- bind_rows(cdf_all)

write_csv(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_auc_medae_all.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  auc_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_auc_medae_all.rds")
)

write_csv(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_cdf_all.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_all,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_cdf_all.rds")
)

# Step 4. Summarise median AUC and MedAE
auc_median <- auc_all %>%
  group_by(n_seed) %>%
  summarise(
    AUC = median(AUC, na.rm = TRUE),
    MedAE = median(MedAE, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_repeat = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_seed))

auc_median

write_csv(
  auc_median,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_auc_medae_median.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  auc_median,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_auc_medae_median.rds")
)

# Step 5. Select representative repeat by median MedAE
representative_runs <- auc_all %>%
  left_join(
    auc_median %>%
      select(n_seed, MedAE_median = MedAE),
    by = "n_seed"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    diff_to_median = abs(MedAE - MedAE_median)
  ) %>%
  group_by(n_seed) %>%
  arrange(diff_to_median, repeat_id) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(n_seed))

representative_runs

write_csv(
  representative_runs,
  file.path(out_dir, "representative_runs_by_median_MedAE.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  representative_runs,
  file.path(out_dir, "representative_runs_by_median_MedAE.rds")
)
```

# Step 6. Build median CDF curve for each seed condition
```{r}

threshold_grid <- seq(0, 12, by = 0.05)

cdf_grid_all <- list()
grid_id <- 1

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {
  
  for (rep_id in seq_len(n_repeat)) {
    
    phase_file <- file.path(
      phase_dir,
      paste0("res_phase_seed", n_seed, "_rep", rep_id, ".rds")
    )
    
    res_phase <- readRDS(phase_file)
    
    res_eval <- res_phase %>%
      left_join(
        metadata %>%
          select(cell, t_true, theta_rad, ZT_sym, celltype),
        by = "cell"
      )
    
    diff_h <- abs((res_eval$ZT_pred - res_eval$t_true) %% 24)
    err_h <- pmin(diff_h, 24 - diff_h)
    
    pct_correct <- sapply(
      threshold_grid,
      function(hrtol) {
        100 * sum(err_h <= hrtol) / length(err_h)
      }
    )
    
    cdf_grid_i <- tibble(
      n_seed = n_seed,
      repeat_id = rep_id,
      threshold_h = threshold_grid,
      pct_correct = pct_correct
    )
    
    cdf_grid_all[[grid_id]] <- cdf_grid_i
    
    grid_id <- grid_id + 1
    
    rm(res_phase, res_eval, diff_h, err_h, pct_correct)
    gc()
  }
}

cdf_grid_all <- bind_rows(cdf_grid_all)

cdf_median <- cdf_grid_all %>%
  group_by(n_seed, threshold_h) %>%
  summarise(
    pct_correct = median(pct_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_seed), threshold_h)

write_csv(
  cdf_median,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_cdf_median_curve.csv")
)

saveRDS(
  cdf_median,
  file.path(out_dir, "seed_number_cdf_median_curve.rds")
)
```


# Step 7. Plot median CDF curves
```{r}
tiff(
  filename = file.path(plot_dir, "seed_number_cell_phase_cdf.tiff"),
  width = 3.2,
  height = 3.2,
  units = "in",
  res = 300,
  compression = "lzw"
)

par(
  family = "serif",
  mar = c(4, 4, 2.5, 1),
  mgp = c(2.1, 0.55, 0),
  tcl = -0.25,
  lwd = 0.5
)

plot(
  NA,
  xlim = c(-0.3, 12.5),
  ylim = c(-2, 102),
  xlab = "Correct to within (hrs)",
  ylab = paste0("% correct (N = ", nrow(metadata), ")"),
  main = "Absolute error CDF",
  cex.main = 0.9,
  cex.lab = 0.8,
  cex.axis = 0.75,
  bty = "n"
)

box(lwd = 0.5)

abline(
  a = 0,
  b = 100 / 12,
  col = "lightgray",
  lwd = 0.7
)

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {
  
  cdf_i <- cdf_median %>%
    filter(n_seed == !!n_seed)
  
  lines(
    cdf_i$threshold_h,
    cdf_i$pct_correct,
    col = seed_cols[as.character(n_seed)],
    lwd = 1.2
  )
}

legend_labels <- c()

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {
  
  auc_i <- auc_median %>%
    filter(n_seed == !!n_seed)
  
  label_i <- paste0(
    n_seed,
    " seeds: ",
    sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$AUC),
    ", ",
    sprintf("%.3f", auc_i$MedAE)
  )
  
  legend_labels <- c(legend_labels, label_i)
}

legend(
  "bottomright",
  legend = c("        AUC, MedAE", legend_labels),
  col = c(NA, seed_cols[as.character(seed_n_vec)]),
  lwd = c(NA, rep(1.2, length(seed_n_vec))),
  bty = "o",
  box.lwd = 0.3,
  cex = 0.62,
  y.intersp = 0.9
)

dev.off()

pdf(
  file = file.path(plot_dir, "seed_number_cell_phase_cdf.pdf"),
  width = 3.2,
  height = 3.2
)

par(
  family = "serif",

box(lwd = 0.5)

for (n_seed in seed_n_vec) {

  lines(
```

# Step 8. Prepare representative scatterplots
```{r}
# Step 8. Prepare representative scatterplots

representative_runs <- readRDS(
  file.path(out_dir, "representative_runs_by_median_MedAE.rds")
)

for (i in seq_len(nrow(representative_runs))) {
  
  n_seed_i <- representative_runs$n_seed[i]
  rep_id_i <- representative_runs$repeat_id[i]
  
  phase_file <- file.path(
    phase_dir,
    paste0("res_phase_seed", n_seed_i, "_rep", rep_id_i, ".rds")
  )
  
  res_phase <- readRDS(phase_file)
  
  point_col_i <- seed_cols[as.character(n_seed_i)]
  
  p_phase <- plot_phase_scatter(
    res_phase = res_phase,
    metadata = metadata,
    truth_by = "t_true",
    pred_by = "ZT_pred",
    point_col = point_col_i
  )
  
  pdf(
    file = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("seed", n_seed_i, "_rep", rep_id_i, "_phase_scatter.pdf")
    ),
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2
  )
  
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()
  
  tiff(
    filename = file.path(
      plot_dir,
      paste0("seed", n_seed_i, "_rep", rep_id_i, "_phase_scatter.tiff")
    ),
    width = 3.2,
    height = 3.2,
    units = "in",
    res = 300,
    compression = "lzw"
  )
  
  print(p_phase$plot)
  dev.off()
}
```
